subject: Object property
notes: cite.py --check 8.4.3.9.3 'Property-name-1 shall be an object property specified in the REPOSITORY paragraph' OK. OoTryBindPropertyReference raises COBOL0843 when the name is absent from data.OoRepositoryProperties (the REPOSITORY PROPERTY specifiers, AS literal-4 honoured per PB974). Probe p5 (no PROPERTY specifier) -> 0843 citing SR1; with the specifier the reference binds (oo_property_ref). A name that is not an accessor of the roster at all is rejected by the generic 1639 (still rejected). OoSpineTests.PropertyReference_NoRepositorySpecifier_0843 is spec-derived (asserts the SR1 rejection). [editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (the object property is part of the OO facility introduced by ISO/IEC 1989:2002; absent from X3.23-1985)] retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/ReferenceResolver.cs#OoTryBindPropertyReference (the one-word property binder ReferenceResolver.OoTryBindPropertyReference is deleted by kb/Work PB1425 (w1021a): a property reference is resolved by ReferenceResolver.ResolveObjectProperty, which splits the chain and resolves identifier-3 through the ordinary resolver)
